quest.title: Why Did a Member of a "Secret Organization" Come Here?
quest.description: You've received a mysterious commission from an "organization whose details may not be disclosed" at the Adventurers' Guild. Specifically, you are to assist the client in completing data collection work on a series of giant monsters, including the Secret Source Automaton: Configuration Device, Legatus Golem, Hydro Tulpa, and Emperor of Fire and Iron. It seems that this might just be a toughie...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Didn't the Guild say that this was a super-tough quest commissioned by an "organization whose details may not be disclosed"? Why's the client a little kid?

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon, I presume? Nice to meet you both. I'm your client, Helka. I trust you've been informed about the details of this commission?

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: In short, I need help gathering information on giant monsters, including combat-related performance data. I look forward to working with you two.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure! Leave it to us... Hang on a sec, we haven't been introduced — how do you know who we are?

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: Considering the difficulty of this commission, the Adventurers' Guild was likely to pass this task on to seasoned adventurers with commensurate experience.

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: And considering that duos consisting of a "golden-haired traveler and little white guide" are rare amongst these more famous candidates...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh, so that's it. You might look like a kid, but you sure know a lot. You even talk kinda like an old...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: *cough* A more composed sort of kid.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, yeah, that! Anyway, are you really our client? Also, this "organization whose details may not be disclosed" thing is kinda...

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: I was indeed the one who issued that commission, and as for the "organization"... Well, Katya taught me to say that.

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: Though I'm reluctant to admit this, an institution with murky origins is more likely to be taken seriously by the Guild than some child with no background to speak of.

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: But the organization's existence, at least, is no lie. I am a part of it.

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: I just told them what I thought they should know. As for what information they got from parsing my words... That's up to their imagination.

choices.text: Is this the sort of organization that occasionally throws parties?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, so it's the kind of "secret organization" that has get-togethers with food... Wait, isn't that just a normal friends' club!?

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: That's right. I made an agreement with Maisie before I left that I wouldn't lie or cheat others, or do anything dangerous. I succeeded in both.

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: Even when telling the truth, one can phrase things in a manner more advantageous to oneself — and with strong enough backing, even dangerous spaces can be made safe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are... are you sure that's how it works?

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: Of course I am. If you're both ready, then, let us set off.
